claims.claim_text: This section explains the basis on which the entity prepares and presents sustainability-related financial disclosures, including how it determines what to disclose, how information is connected to financial statements and other general purpose financial reports, and how disclosures are organised across IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards core content pillars.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: 1.0 How to read this section (basis of preparation)
claims.support_notes: Introductory narrative; no specific requirement mapping provided in supported_requirements.

claims.claim_text: Key preparation principles applied include relevance and materiality, faithful representation, connectivity and consistency.
claims.support_notes: High-level principles stated; not directly tied to a specific requirement in the provided supported_requirements list.

claims.claim_text: The sustainability-related financial disclosures are intended to provide information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect cash flows, access to finance or cost of capital over the short, medium or long term (i.e., prospects).
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 3 objective wording as included in supported_requirements.

claims.claim_text: To identify sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect prospects, the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B1–B12.
claims.support_notes: Directly aligns with requirement to apply B1–B12 to identify risks/opportunities affecting prospects.

claims.claim_text: The entity provides additional information when compliance with specifically applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards would not, on its own, enable users to understand effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities on cash flows, access to finance and cost of capital over the short, medium and long term.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Substantively mirrors IFRS S1.15(b) requirement to disclose additional information when necessary for user understanding.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses material information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect prospects.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 17 requirement.

claims.claim_text: In identifying and disclosing material information, the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B13–B37.
claims.support_notes: Directly aligns with requirement to apply B13–B37 for materiality identification/disclosure.

claims.claim_text: The sustainability-related financial disclosures are prepared for the same reporting entity as the related financial statements.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 20 requirement.

claims.claim_text: The entity presents information to enable users to understand connections within sustainability-related financial disclosures, including between governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Aligns with IFRS S1.21(b)(i) requirement on internal connectivity across core content areas.

claims.claim_text: The entity presents information to enable users to understand connections across sustainability-related financial disclosures and other general purpose financial reports it publishes, including the related financial statements.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Aligns with IFRS S1.21(b)(ii) requirement on connectivity across reports including financial statements.

claims.claim_text: The entity identifies the financial statements to which the sustainability-related financial disclosures relate.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 22 requirement.

claims.claim_text: To the extent possible, the entity uses data and assumptions consistent with those used in preparing the related financial statements, considering IFRS Accounting Standards or other applicable GAAP.
claims.support_notes: Directly aligns with IFRS S1 paragraph 23 requirement.

claims.claim_text: When currency is specified as a unit of measure in the sustainability-related financial disclosures, the entity uses the presentation currency of the related financial statements.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 24 requirement.

claims.claim_text: Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures across core content areas: governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets.
claims.support_notes: Supported for governance (25(a)), risk management (25(c)), and metrics/targets (25(d)) based on provided requirements; strategy (25(b)) is stated in draft but not included in the provided supported_requirements list.

claims.claim_text: In identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect prospects, the entity applies IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 54 requirement.

claims.claim_text: The entity refers to and considers the applicability of the disclosure topics in the SASB Standards.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 55(a) requirement.

claims.claim_text: When a specific IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard applies to a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, the entity applies that Standard’s disclosure requirements.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 56 requirement.

claims.claim_text: When no IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard specifically applies, the entity uses judgement to identify information that is relevant to users’ decision-making and faithfully represents the risk or opportunity.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
evidence_sources: IFRS S1.57(a) and IFRS S1.57(b) cited in draft
claims.support_notes: Directly aligns with IFRS S1 paragraph 57(a) and 57(b) requirements.

claims.claim_text: In making the judgement when no specific IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard applies, the entity refers to and considers the applicability of metrics associated with SASB disclosure topics.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 58(a) requirement.

claims.claim_text: The entity identifies the specific standards, pronouncements, industry practice and other sources of guidance applied in preparing the sustainability-related financial disclosures (including, if applicable, SASB disclosure topics).
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 59(a) requirement.

claims.claim_text: The entity identifies the industry(s) specified in IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, the SASB Standards or other sources of guidance that it applied in preparing the sustainability-related financial disclosures, including in identifying applicable metrics.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 59(b) requirement.

claims.claim_text: Information required by an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard may be included in the sustainability-related financial disclosures by cross-reference to another report the entity publishes; when using cross-references, the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B45–B47.
claims.support_notes: Direct match to IFRS S1 paragraph 63 requirement.

claims.claim_text: The entity reports sustainability-related financial disclosures at the same time as the related financial statements and covers the same reporting period.
